tagline.en: The classic way to animate a Stable Diffusion image model — a plug-in motion module turns text prompts into short videos.
tagline.zh: 让 Stable Diffusion 图像模型动起来的经典方案——一个可插拔的运动模块,把文本提示词变成短视频。

en: AnimateDiff is a widely-used approach for turning a text-to-image diffusion model into a text-to-video generator. Rather than training a video model from scratch, it inserts a learned motion module into a frozen Stable Diffusion backbone so the frames move coherently.

Because it builds on the Stable Diffusion v1.5 ecosystem, it pairs naturally with community image checkpoints (the default demo uses a RealisticVision-style base) and a CLIP text encoder. The motion module is the reusable piece that adds temporal consistency on top of whatever image model you plug in.
In WorldFoundry, AnimateDiff runs through the shared video pipeline: give it a text prompt and it renders a short animated clip. The primary AnimateDiff weights are Apache-2.0 licensed.
zh: AnimateDiff 是把文生图扩散模型改造成文生视频生成器的一种广泛使用的方法。它不从零训练视频模型,而是在冻结的 Stable Diffusion 主干中插入一个学习到的运动模块,使各帧连贯运动。
由于它构建在 Stable Diffusion v1.5 生态之上,可以自然地搭配社区图像 checkpoint(默认 demo 使用 RealisticVision 风格的底模)以及 CLIP 文本编码器。运动模块是可复用的核心组件,它为你接入的任意图像模型叠加时序一致性。
在 WorldFoundry 中,AnimateDiff 通过共享视频 pipeline 运行:给它一段文本提示词,它就会渲染一小段动画片段。AnimateDiff 主权重采用 Apache-2.0 许可。

whenToUse.en: A good fit when you want to animate the familiar Stable Diffusion v1.5 style and reuse existing image checkpoints, or when you want a lightweight, well-understood route into text-to-video.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想为熟悉的 Stable Diffusion v1.5 画风注入动态、并复用已有图像 checkpoint,或想要一条轻量、成熟的文生视频入口时,它很合适。

notFor.en: Not the choice for long-form or highly cinematic video — it produces short clips, and quality is tied to the SD v1.5-era backbone rather than newer large video models.
notFor.zh: 不适合长视频或追求高度电影感的场景——它生成的是短片段,画质也受限于 SD v1.5 时代的主干,而非更新的大型视频模型。
